# Pātimokkhaṭṭhapanakkhandhaka (Kd 19)

**ID:** Kd 19
**Section:** Khandhaka (kd)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Pātimokkhaṭṭhapanakkhandhaka
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m3.mul8.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Pātimokkhaṭṭhapanakkhandhaka* ("The chapter on the cancellation of the Monastic Code") is the nineteenth chapter of the Khandhaka division in the Vinaya Piṭaka and constitutes the ninth chapter of the *Cullavagga* [Hazra 1994; ICTS 2017]. The text regulates the procedures governing the suspension or cancellation of the fortnightly recitation of the Pātimokkha, permitting a monastic to exclude another who has unconfessed monastic offenses from participating. In addition to these exclusion procedures, the chapter sets forth the essential personal qualities and ethical duties required of a monk before he attempts to reprove or correct another monastic. It also incorporates an exposition on the eight wonderful qualities of the great ocean (*Mahāsamuddeatthacchariya*), which shares textual material with the *Pahārāda Sutta* (AN 8.19) and the *Uposatha Sutta* (AN 8.20 / Ud 5.5) [ICTS 2017].

 Passage-level parallels exist with the *Udāna* (Ud 5.5), the *Kusinārasutta* (AN 10.44), the *Sirimaṇḍattheragāthā* (Thag 6.13), and the *Udānavarga* (UV 6). The text has been studied comparatively against the Mūlasarvāstivāda *Poṣadhasthāpanavastu* by Phra Weerachai Lueritthikul, and has been translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali [Lueritthikul 2015].
